name: Sumble
summary: Organization, people, job post and team data: what companies use, who works there and buying signals.
notes: Credit-priced: every call costs credits (base per row plus paid attributes and metrics); an unaffordable call answers 402 before any work.
The core endpoints are each one composable call: send a list to resolve or a filter to search, plus select to choose attributes. Page with limit and offset.
List management, events, intelligence briefs, conversations and support endpoints exist but are not listed.

endpoints.name: Resolve or search organizations
endpoints.summary: Resolve a list of companies, or search by technology, job function, industry and firmographic filters, choosing which attributes and per-entity metrics come back.

organizations.description: Organizations to resolve and enrich; mutually exclusive with filter.

filter.description: Advanced query selecting organizations, e.g. {query: "technology EQ 'python'"}; mutually exclusive with organizations.

select.description: What to return: {attributes: [...], entities: [...] per-entity metric selections}.

include_closed.description: Filter mode: include permanently closed organizations.

match_source.description: Filter mode: which evidence may match; any (default) or job_post only.

order_by_column.description: Column to order by, filter mode only.

file_name.description: Return a downloadable file instead of inline results: a name ending .csv, .xlsx or .json.

notes: A read over POST: the query is in the body.
Costs 1 base credit per organization, plus 1 per paid attribute (id, name, slug, url, sumble_url, linkedin_url and account_status are free), plus per-entity metrics.
Look up valid technology, job function and location values with technologies.find, jobs.title_lookup and locations.find.

endpoints.name: Resolve or search people
endpoints.summary: Resolve a list of people, or search by organization and role or a plain-language search; attributes can include contact details.

people.description: People to resolve and enrich, one row per entry; mutually exclusive with filter.

filter.description: Organization scope plus an advanced query or a plain-language search; mutually exclusive with people.

select.description: What to return: {attributes: [...] or 'all', related_people}. Email and phone and profile attributes must be requested explicitly.

requested_total.description: With filter.search: the maximum people for the whole search across pages; keep it fixed while paging.

order_by_column.description: start_date, job_level or person_score; filter mode only.

file_name.description: Return a downloadable file instead of inline results: a name ending .csv, .xlsx or .json.

notes: Credit-priced per row and per attribute; contact reveals cost the most (10 credits per email, 80 per phone, first reveal only).

endpoints.name: Resolve or search job posts
endpoints.summary: Job posts by organization and filters, with descriptions, extracted technologies, teams and hiring-manager candidates optional.

jobs.description: Job ids to enrich; mutually exclusive with filter.

filter.description: Query selecting the jobs; mutually exclusive with jobs.

file_name.description: Return a downloadable file instead of inline results: a name ending .csv, .xlsx or .json.

notes: Credit-priced per row and attribute; 'all' attributes grows in cost as the endpoint gains attributes.

endpoints.name: Resolve or search teams
endpoints.summary: Teams extracted from job posts, with ICP fit score, related people and job posts optional.

teams.description: Team ids to retrieve; mutually exclusive with filter.

filter.description: Query selecting the teams; mutually exclusive with teams.

order_by_column.description: jobs_count (default), first_activity or last_activity; filter mode only.

notes: Each related person or job post returned costs 1 credit.

endpoints.name: Get an organization's signals
endpoints.summary: Recent account signals for one organization.

technology_slugs.description: Technology slugs to filter by; repeat the parameter.

notes: Resolve technology slugs with technologies.lookup or technologies.find.

endpoints.name: Get an organization's tech stack
endpoints.summary: Technologies an organization uses, by category.

endpoints.name: Find technologies by name
endpoints.summary: Search the technology catalog for names and slugs.

endpoints.name: Find location codes
endpoints.summary: Location codes for filters, by search text or by listing the children of a region, country or state.

query.description: Search country, state and city names; leave parent out.

parent.description: Region, country or state code whose children to list, e.g. EMEA, US, US:Texas; codes are case-sensitive.

notes: A read over POST. Send query or parent, not both; both omitted lists top-level regions and countries.

endpoints.name: Look up function and level for job titles
endpoints.summary: The canonical job function and level for each title.

endpoints.name: Search signals
endpoints.summary: Recent account signals by organization, person, technology, job function, list or signal id.

filter.description: {organization_ids, person_ids, signal_ids, technology_slugs, job_functions, priorities, account_list_ids, signal_config_ids}, all optional lists.

file_name.description: Return a downloadable file instead of inline results: a name ending .csv, .xlsx or .json.
